## `TextEditController` { #texteditcontroller-sealed-class }

`public sealed class TextEditController`

Persistent editing state, independent of short-lived ECS entity IDs. Platform adapters can publish complete snapshots without racing a render-thread read.

**Constructeurs**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `TextEditController(string initialText = "", int historyLimit = 100)` |  |

**Propriétés**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `TextEditingValue Value { get; }` |  |
| `bool CanRedo { get; }` |  |
| `bool CanUndo { get; }` |  |
| `bool HasDeferredExternalUpdate { get; }` |  |
| `int ExternalUpdatePolicy { get; set; }` |  |
| `int UndoCount { get; }` |  |
| `long Version { get; }` |  |

**Méthodes**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `IDisposable BeginBatchEdit()` | Coalesces edits into one Changed notification and one undo transaction until the returned scope is disposed. No lock is held while the batch is open: the batch body may call the engine or await, and edits made by other threads meanwhile join the same transaction. |
| `bool Redo()` |  |
| `bool Undo()` |  |
| `string GetSelectedText()` |  |
| `string GetTextAfterSelection(int maxLength)` |  |
| `string GetTextBeforeSelection(int maxLength)` |  |
| `void ApplyNativeSnapshot(TextEditingValue value)` | Imports an OS-owned editor snapshot. Provisional composing updates share one undo transaction, while the final committed snapshot closes it. |
| `void CommitText(string text, int caret)` | Commits text from an IME, replacing composition or selection. |
| `void CommitTextRelative(string text, int newCursorPosition)` | Commits text using Android InputConnection's relative caret convention. Positive positions count from the inserted text's end; zero and negative positions count from its start. The whole operation is atomic. |
| `void DeleteBackward()` | Deletes a complete user-perceived character, not one UTF-16 code unit. |
| `void DeleteSurroundingCodePoints(int beforeLength, int afterLength)` | Android's code-point deletion counts Unicode scalar values rather than UTF-16 units, so a supplementary character is never split in half. |
| `void DeleteSurroundingText(int beforeLength, int afterLength)` | Android's deleteSurroundingText uses UTF-16 units outside the current selection. This operation preserves any text currently selected. |
| `void FinishComposition()` |  |
| `void ReplaceSelection(string text, int origin = Programmatic)` | Replaces the current selection as one undoable edit. |
| `void SelectAll(int origin = Programmatic)` | Selects the whole text. |
| `void SetComposingRange(TextRange? range)` | Marks existing text as provisional without changing the selection. |
| `void SetComposingText(string text, int caret)` | Replaces the current composing region, or the selection when composition starts. The caret is an absolute UTF-16 offset in the resulting text. |
| `void SetSelection(TextSelection selection, int origin = Programmatic)` |  |
| `void SetText(string text, int origin = Programmatic)` | Replaces the whole text and puts the caret at its end. |
| `void SetValue(TextEditingValue value, int origin = Programmatic)` | Replaces the value supplied by the application or a platform adapter. |
